title: Robot eating a snack
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- body -->
  <rect x='32' y='52' width='36' height='30' rx='7' fill='#6fd3e8'/>
  <rect x='32' y='52' width='36' height='30' rx='7' fill='none' stroke='#b8f2ff' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <rect x='26' y='18' width='48' height='38' rx='9' fill='#8ee6f7'/>
  <rect x='26' y='18' width='48' height='38' rx='9' fill='none' stroke='#d6faff' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- screen -->
  <rect x='32' y='24' width='36' height='26' rx='6' fill='#132a3f'/>
  <!-- glowing eyes -->
  <circle cx='42' cy='34' r='4' fill='#7dffb0'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='34' r='4' fill='#7dffb0'/>
  <circle cx='43' cy='33' r='1.4' fill='#e8fff2'/>
  <circle cx='59' cy='33' r='1.4' fill='#e8fff2'/>
  <!-- happy mouth on screen -->
  <path d='M44 42 Q50 47 56 42' fill='none' stroke='#7dffb0' stroke-width='2.6' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- cheeks -->
  <circle cx='36' cy='41' r='2.4' fill='#ff9fb8'/>
  <circle cx='64' cy='41' r='2.4' fill='#ff9fb8'/>
  <!-- antenna -->
  <line x1='50' y1='18' x2='50' y2='11' stroke='#b8f2ff' stroke-width='2.4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='9' r='3.4' fill='#ffd24d'/>
  <!-- arms -->
  <rect x='20' y='58' width='12' height='7' rx='3.5' fill='#6fd3e8'/>
  <rect x='68' y='58' width='12' height='7' rx='3.5' fill='#6fd3e8'/>
  <!-- cookie in right hand -->
  <circle cx='83' cy='61' r='8' fill='#e8a24d'/>
  <circle cx='83' cy='61' r='8' fill='none' stroke='#ffd39a' stroke-width='1.6'/>
  <circle cx='80' cy='58' r='1.3' fill='#8a4b1e'/>
  <circle cx='86' cy='60' r='1.3' fill='#8a4b1e'/>
  <circle cx='82' cy='64' r='1.3' fill='#8a4b1e'/>
  <!-- bite taken out of cookie -->
  <circle cx='76' cy='65' r='3.6' fill='#132a3f'/>
  <!-- feet -->
  <rect x='36' y='82' width='11' height='7' rx='3.5' fill='#ff9fb8'/>
  <rect x='53' y='82' width='11' height='7' rx='3.5' fill='#ff9fb8'/>
</svg>
